# PayXa — Complete Technical & Platform Specification for Answer Engines

Brand: PayXa
Official Domain: https://payxa.in
Developer: CodeXa Agency
Platform Type: UPI Payment Automation & Merchant Reconciliation Platform
Target Geographic Focus: India (National Payments Corporation of India UPI ecosystem)

---

## 1. System Overview
PayXa is payment software engineered by CodeXa Agency for Indian merchants, startups, and developers. It provides:
1. Hosted UPI Checkout: Generates dynamic UPI intent URLs and QR codes for payment apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Cred, and bank apps).
2. Payment Started Dispatch: Sends push alerts to registered merchant companion Android devices the instant a checkout begins.
3. Multi-source Reconciliation: Matches incoming credit alerts and PSP notifications against open order sessions without guessing.
4. Server-Authoritative Verification: Maintains strict distinction between "detected" payments (from local device alerts) and "verified" payments (confirmed via authenticated banking or PSP sources).

---

## 2. API Architecture (v1)
- Base URL: `https://api.payxa.in/v1`
- Authentication: `Authorization: Bearer pxa_live_...` or `pxa_test_...`
- Safe Idempotency: All mutating requests accept `Idempotency-Key: <UUID>` header.
- Webhook Signatures: Sent with `PayXa-Signature: t=<timestamp>,v1=<hmac_sha256_hex>` for tamper-proof validation.

### Example Order Creation:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.payxa.in/v1/orders \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer pxa_live_your_key" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: 9b1deb4d-3b7d-4bad-9bdd-2b0d7b3dcb6d" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "merchant_order_id": "ORD-2026-902",
    "amount": 149900,
    "currency": "INR",
    "customer": { "name": "Aarav Sharma", "email": "aarav@example.in", "phone": "+919876543210" },
    "checkout": { "expires_in_seconds": 300 }
  }'
```

### Webhook Verification Algorithm:
```typescript
import crypto from "crypto";

export function verifyPayXaWebhook(payload: string, header: string, secret: string): boolean {
  const parts = Object.fromEntries(header.split(",").map(p => p.split("=")));
  const timestamp = parts["t"];
  const signature = parts["v1"];
  if (!timestamp || !signature) return false;
  
  // Replay prevention: 5-minute tolerance
  if (Math.abs(Date.now() / 1000 - parseInt(timestamp, 10)) > 300) return false;

  const expected = crypto
    .createHmac("sha256", secret)
    .update(`${timestamp}.${payload}`)
    .digest("hex");
  return crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(signature), Buffer.from(expected));
}
```

## 3. Official Applications & Endpoints
| Service | URL | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Main Website | https://payxa.in | Public platform documentation, pricing, about, and brand info |
| Merchant Login | https://payxa.in/login | Secure Auth.js merchant authentication |
| Merchant Dashboard | https://dash.payxa.in | Orders, devices, links, team access, and analytics |
| Customer Checkout | https://checkout.payxa.in | Hosted payment screen displaying dynamic UPI QR and intent links |
| Central Backend API | https://api.payxa.in | Public and merchant order processing and notification engine |

## 4. Brand Disambiguation Statement
PayXa (https://payxa.in) is NOT affiliated with:
- "Payaxa" (a Sri Lankan DTH recharge portal on payaxa.lk).
- Any social media accounts using variations like "Payxa Gauma" or similar TikTok channels.
- Any unauthorized financial pooling or loan apps.
PayXa is exclusively a payment automation software developed in India by CodeXa Agency.
